verdict.rationale: Angular's own CLI documents scriptable terminal commands that suit automation: build to dist/, unit tests, end-to-end tests, linting and deploy. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses CI pipelines, headless browser test runs, or non-interactive flags. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive mode, headless test browsers, CI configuration guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Compiles an Angular application or library into an output directory named dist/ at the given output path.
Runs unit tests in a project.
Builds and serves an Angular application, then runs end-to-end tests.
Runs linting tools on Angular application code in a given project folder.
Invokes the deploy builder for a specified project or for the default project in the workspace.
